- Separate invoices issued to each legal entity (preferred), OR

1) Can Redwood issue localized VAT invoices per EU entity?
2) If we get a consolidated invoice, will you provide a machine-readable allocation file that our AP team can ingest?

Hi Eva — really helpful, thanks for the clear requirements. Short answers up front, then a recommended plan.

Quick answers:
- Yes, we can support either approach.
  * Option A — Split invoices: we can issue per-entity invoices (UK + DE) if you provide the exact legal names and VAT/Tax IDs.
  * Option B — Consolidated invoice + allocation CSV: we can generate a consolidated invoice and provide an allocations CSV that maps line items to cost centers/entities.
- Split payments: supported, but we need an agreed allocation record and explicit net terms tied to each invoice.
- VAT handling: for EU-localized VAT invoices we generally require localized billing setup (we have an EU billing flow that supports this; if you need Redwood to invoice from an EU VAT-registered entity we’ll confirm the path).

Recommended mutual action plan (proposed, 5 items):
1) You confirm preferred invoice model (A or B) and provide legal names + VAT IDs for each entity.
2) Procurement shares PO (we’ll accept PO + DocuSign SOW).
3) Redwood generates sample invoice(s) + allocations CSV for your AP to validate.
4) Finance sync between our billing lead and your AP to confirm fields and CSV columns (30 minutes).
5) Finalize SOW and billing terms (DocuSign) + schedule pilot kickoff.

I’ve attached a concise flow doc that shows the split vs consolidated paths and a VAT matrix for common EU cases. If you’re OK with this plan I’ll loop in finance and have a sample invoice to you by EOD tomorrow.

Next available times for short finance sync: Tue 08/04 09:30–11:00 BST or Wed 08/05 14:00–15:00 BST. Which works best for you?

Thanks — cc’ing Monica (billing lead) and Laura (customer success) to pick up operational and onboarding items.

Best,

Hi Eva / Ben — Monica from Redwood finance. Quick operational notes to make sure AP has everything they need: 

1) Invoice fields we need to populate for EU VAT invoices: legal name, billing address, VAT/Tax ID, purchase order number, purchase contact email, and exact remit-to entity.
2) If you choose split invoices (Option A), each invoice will have its own invoice number and payment terms. Net terms can differ per invoice if you require (we’ll reflect that on each invoice).
3) For consolidated invoice + allocation CSV (Option B): we’ll include a header row with cost_center_id, entity, line_item_description, unit_price, quantity, tax_amount, net_amount, gross_amount. We can also include a 'ledger_code' column if you provide mapping.
4) Intercompany treatment: if one legal entity pays and the services are consumed by another, you’ll want an intercompany memo. I’ve attached an intercompany_memo_template.docx we typically use.
5) Timing: once PO+SOW are signed, we can produce sample invoice(s) within 24 business hours.

One caveat on VAT: if you want Redwood to issue invoices from a localized EU VAT-registered entity (i.e., invoices that show a GB or DE VAT registration for Redwood), that requires a short contract amendment while we align tax reporting. If that’s required, please flag and we’ll loop in taxes/legal.

Happy to join the finance sync — I’m available Tue 08/04 10:00–11:30 BST.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: intercompany_memo_template.docx
